attempts.prompt:
EDIT ONLY THE PERSON in image 1. Image 1 is the exact original game portrait/card and the sole authority for visible features, composition, clothing and exterior. Image 2 is only the user mascot identity reference: a fictional yellow 奶龙 with a compact round head, short broad neck, solid black oval eyes with green rings and no white sclera, one small mouth at the actual original mouth position, and no human nose, ears or skin. If a moustache is present, the one mouth remains below it; never add a second gray slit or default mascot lip above the moustache.

SOURCE-VISIBLE FEATURES TO PRESERVE:
Dark olive peaked cap with a shiny black visor, gold piping/cord, an upper gold eagle and a separate lower red-centered gold wreath/cockade; the hairline is covered, with short dark-brown temple hair and narrow sideburns visible. Brown eyebrows, no glasses, no moustache or beard, and a clean-shaven smooth chin visible in near-profile. Dark olive uniform with gold shoulder boards, red collar patches with gold emblems, a white pointed shirt collar, dark tie largely behind one black-and-silver neck cross.
Retain the actual source hair, eyebrows, facial-hair extent, headgear, eyewear, clothing and decorations only where visibly present. Do not copy a bare scalp or missing eyebrows from the mascot reference over real source hair. Do not invent features from names or biographies.

COMPOSITION, EXPRESSION AND LIGHT:
Preserve the right-facing near-profile head-and-upper-chest pose, gaze toward image right, upright neck and serious closed mouth. Keep the cap near the top, shoulders cropped by the sides and upper chest clipped at the bottom; retain warm directional modeling on the profile and the deep shadow beneath the cap visor.
Fit the existing collar naturally around a rounded chin and very short broad neck transition while preserving its original open/closed state. No long neck column, pinched collar, floating cloth, clipping or cream bib. Preserve exactly one source-appropriate mouth and expression.

BACKGROUND, FRAME AND EXTERIOR:
The entire source is an opaque rectangular painted portrait with no transparent outside region, frame or note. Lock the real pale muted gray-olive/greige backplate, including its original color, brightness, fine mottling and gentle vignette behind the profile and uniform. Add no transparency, replacement background, frame, note, halo or smoke.

OPAQUE RGB WORKING PASS AND EVIDENCE LIMITS:
This is the authorized best-RGB pass. Source alpha will be restored separately only after actual visual RGB review, using the recorded source-alpha BILINEAR method without changing RGB. Do not request or paint a checkerboard or green screen. Keep all original opaque backing, cloth and paper solid; no interior holes, haze or see-through fabric. Fine cap and collar insignia and the interior of the small neck cross are not reliably readable at 156x210. Do not invent readable writing, extra note rows, symbols, people or comparison panels. Keep full returned detail and the source composition; no watermark.
